messages:
Matt (Sales): Quick sync — enterprise prospect (FinTech) asked for a short POC plan, security checklist, and a cost estimate. Can we align on scope?
Elaine (PM): TL;DR: they want invoice extraction + semantic search over 2 years of docs, plus realtime QA bot for ops. Success metrics: extraction F1 >= 0.92, search MRR@10 improvement > 15%, end-to-end latency for chat < 400ms 95th.
Asha (Solutions): Questions re: data flow — will customer stream documents to our hosted API or want Private deployment? This changes encryption/KMS and pricing.
Matt (Sales): They've asked for hosted first, with an option to move to Dedicated later. Security wants to see redacted data plan and answers to the standard questionnaire.
Devon (Eng): Model fit thoughts: extraction needs strong structured output + tool-calling for calling an internal normalized schema. Recommend a Causal model with tool calling support (function calls) and 32k context to fit multi-page invoices and surrounding memos. For semantic search/rerank: dense embeddings + MIPS reranker or cross-encoder for top-10 re-rank.
Asha (Solutions): Agree. Suggested POC components: 1) small labeled set (200 invoices) for extraction evals, 2) 10k doc corpus for embedding index tests, 3) prompt/eval harness for chat QA. Timeline: 3 weeks (prep+run+eval).
Elaine (PM): Can we make the success criteria explicit in the proposal: dataset sizes, eval scripts, baseline models, and rollback criteria? Also include SLA expectations for hosted trial.
Devon (Eng): Baselines: 1) extraction w/ model-x-16k (finetuned prompt + JSON schema). 2) embeddings: dense model-a-1536 + faiss HNSW. For rerank: cheap first-pass with approximate sim then cross-encoder model-b-2k for rerank.
Matt (Sales): Pricing question from buyer: ballpark token cost for 3-week POC at expected traffic (50 users, 2000 chat tokens/day each). Asha — can you help with a cost estimate and whether dedicated trial discount applies?
Asha (Solutions): Rough calc: embedding index build ~0.4M tokens, chat traffic ~10M tokens over 3 weeks. At hosted list rates estimate ~$1,200 + infra charges. If they commit to Dedicated pilot (monthly) we can offer 25% pilot credit. I'll draft numbers.
Devon (Eng): Security notes to include in the questionnaire: data residency (EU), KMS integration, audit logs retention (90 days), RBAC, and option for Private control plane. Also note model fallback policy if a requested variant is unavailable (auto-route to compatible quantized variant).
SecBot: Security checklist uploaded: https://redwood.internal/sec/q1-fintech-checklist (redacted link preview).
Elaine (PM): For the POC deliverables: 1) extraction model with schema + evaluation report, 2) embedding index + MRR report, 3) chat integration with tool-calls + latency report, 4) handoff docs + runbook.
Matt (Sales): I'll send the scope doc to the buyer by EOD. Need a short blurb for the exec sponsor summarizing risk/mitigation and timeline. Can someone add a 3-line summary?
Asha (Solutions): 3-line exec blurb: "Redwood will run a 3-week technical pilot to validate invoice extraction and semantic search at scale. Success gates: extraction F1 >= 0.92, search MRR uplift >15%, chat latency under 400ms at 95th. Hosted trial with optional Dedicated transition; security controls and KMS available on request"
Devon (Eng): Action items: I'll prepare a small demo script and eval harness (by tomorrow). Asha please attach cost spreadsheet. Elaine please finalize success criteria in the SOW. Matt follow up with buyer and attach SecBot link.
Matt (Sales): Great — will do. Quick flag: buyer also asked whether we support incremental embedding updates (yes?) and partial re-indexing.
Devon (Eng): Yes — we support incremental ops: upsert vectors and cold-start indexing. We'll document expected indexing time for 10k inserts on their target Dedicated tier.
Asha (Solutions): One more: they asked about hallucination mitigation in chat. Recommend: 1) retrieval-augmented generation, 2) conservative temperature, 3) QA checks in evals; include automated regression alerts in Redwood Optimize.
Matt (Sales): Awesome. If no objections I'll send scope + SOW + security checklist to buyer. :thumbsup:
Elaine (PM): No objections. Keep me looped on any red flags.
Devon (Eng): I'll add the model version pins and fallback policy in the SOW notes.
SecBot: Reminder: add "data processing addendum" for EU customers.
